mostWorthwhile.text: Measuring the essential load and using it to estimate reserve time made the power plan concrete, especially the distinction between cycling peaks and average load.

leastWorthwhile.text: The successive reserve connections felt somewhat procedural, although the empty battery connector clarified why another step was needed.

surprise.text: I expected to measure the cooler directly, but the meter instead measured the essential-equipment panel, including its cycling peaks.

arbitrary.text: My initial battery-to-backup-unit attempt did not make the next operation obvious to me; the automatic measurement-based estimate clarified its purpose afterward.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the practical repair details and the story's concern for keeping the clinic working made me curious about what happens next.
